title: I Can Draw That! Step-by-Step Fun
developmental_focus: Fine-motor sequencing, shape composition, and following multi-step visual instructions. Ages 4-5 can hold a pencil with a tripod grip and follow 3-6 step sequences.
safety_notes: No scissors, blades, or unsupervised tool use depicted; drawing tools limited to crayons/markers/pencils held by the character.
Each drawing broken into no more than 6 numbered steps, using only basic shapes (circles, triangles, lines) per step.
Consistent numbering style and step-highlight color across the whole book.
Encouraging, non-competitive tone in all text (no 'wrong way' framing).
